bagPolicy.summary: All bags are searched at the door. Backpacks, suitcases and large bags are not allowed inside.
bagPolicy.quote: All bags are subject to search upon entry. Backpacks, suitcases, and large bags will not permitted inside the venue.

parking.summary: Street parking in the CBD is free after 7pm. Meters are enforced from 8am to 7pm, Monday through Saturday.
parking.quote: On-street parking in the CBD is free after 7PM (Meters are enforced from 8AM to 7PM, Monday through Saturday).

rideshare.summary: The Civic is reachable by taxi and rideshare, as well as streetcar and bus. The venue hasn't published a dedicated pickup zone, so set your pickup to 510 O'Keefe Avenue.
rideshare.quote: The Civic is also accessible by streetcar, bus, taxi, and ride-share services.

concessions.summary: There's a bar on each floor with beer, wine, spirits and non-alcoholic drinks. The Civic doesn't serve food. The venue is cashless and takes Visa, Mastercard, Discover and Amex.
concessions.quote: The Civic features a bar on each floor, offering a wide selection of non-alcoholic beverages, beer, wine, and spirits.

accessibility.summary: ADA seating is available for every show on the first floor. There is no elevator to the upper levels.
accessibility.quote: We offer ADA seating for every show on our first floor.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed during shows.
reEntry.quote: We are unable to offer re-entry during shows.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Fridays from 12pm to 5pm and one hour before doors on show days. Tickets can be scanned from your phone, and the box office window can reprint tickets on show night. Shows are all ages unless the ticketing page says otherwise.
ticketPickup.quote: Open every Friday from 12PM-5PM and one hour before doors on show days.

gates.summary: Door times are listed in each show's description on Ticketmaster. Bags are searched as you enter.
gates.quote: You can find each show’s door time listed in its description on Ticketmaster.
